propositions: The BindingStore facade must delegate binding load/save and unit-of-work persistence to BindingRepository while preserving all public imports, constructor signatures, method signatures, and caller-visible exceptions.
Pending, confirmed, and reverse lookup queries plus shallow all_bindings() behavior must remain functionally identical after delegation to the repository.
Facade save/reload must produce byte-identical state and preserve the same exception surface as before repository delegation.
Peer-state and rotation ownership must remain independent and callers must never receive direct writable repository access.
Legacy persistence format and exception behavior must be retained after removing only dead code made obsolete by delegation.
